Experimental variogram and fitted models

Semivariance of all point pairs grouped by distance class. Dot size shows how many pairs each class holds.

Directional variograms

0° runs north to south and 90° runs west to east, with a 22.5° tolerance. The west to east direction reaches much higher semivariance: precipitation is anisotropic.

Model comparison

The spatial model with the lowest AIC is selected. The nonspatial AIC is the reference: when it is higher, there is spatial dependence.

Sampling points

Each point is the centroid of a locality. Click a header to sort, or a row to locate it on the map.

Data: mean annual precipitation at locality centroids in Salta and Jujuy (course dataset). Ordinary kriging with a spherical model fitted by REML in R (geoR). Basemap: Esri World Imagery.
